description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in morphosyntactic probing performance between two multilingual BERT models, mBERT and XLM-R, across four different model configurations along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, scaled linearly from -0.2 to +0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays four grouped bar pairs, each corresponding to a model configuration: “hidden:[50], linear”, “hidden:[], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”. For each configuration, a light blue bar represents the mBERT model and a dark blue bar represents the XLM-R model. In the “hidden:[50], linear” configuration, the mBERT bar extends down to approximately -0.2, while the XLM-R bar extends down to approximately -0.15. In the “hidden:[], linear” configuration, the mBERT bar extends up to approximately +0.1, while the XLM-R bar extends up to approximately +0.2. In the “hidden:[100], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar extends down to approximately -0.1, while the XLM-R bar extends up to approximately +0.05. In the “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU” configuration, the mBERT bar extends down to approximately -0.18, while the XLM-R bar extends down to approximately -0.15. The bars are not sorted by value and are presented in the order of the model configurations as labeled on the x-axis.
